children: Industrial production in Moldova rose by 7.1% year-on-year in July 2026, easing from a three-month high of 10.6% in the previous month.

Output growth slowed in manufacturing (6.2% vs 10.2% in June), weighed down by notable decreases in food products (11.1% vs 18.4%), textiles (24.7% vs 40.1%), computers, electronics, and optical products (14.3% vs 36.2%), and metal construction and metal products (15.2% vs 19.4%).
Moreover, activity also moderated in the electricity, gas, steam, and air-conditioning supply sector (18.0% vs 19.4%).
On the other hand, production growth accelerated in mining and quarrying (20.5% vs 10.3%).
On a monthly basis, industrial output increased by 7.6% in July, rebounding from a 0.9% decline in the preceding period.
In the January–July period, industrial production rose by 7.7%.

title: Moldova Industrial Output Growth Slows in July
